system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Submits PMKSY irrigation support application. For your information, my area_hectares is dummy_area_hectares_1366, my land_parcel_id is dummy_land_parcel_id_4336, my irrigation_type is dummy_irrigation_type_5163, my project_cost is dummy_project_cost_9761, my aadhaar_number is 100020002116.

function.name: pmksy_submit_application
function.description: Submits PMKSY irrigation support application. Transitions application_status to 'submitted'. Farmer must be eligible. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve. Fails if ineligible, duplicate, or details incomplete.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

area_hectares.description: Area to be irrigated in hectares.
